Record Class FlakeModels.FlakeTable

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.doctor.history.FlakeModels.FlakeTable
Record Components:
schemaVersion - response schema
empty - whether no rows could be produced (no history and no retries)
emptyMessage - user-facing empty-state text when empty is true
windowSize - max launches considered for transition counting (TestOps-style, default 10)
transitionThreshold - min transitions to tag transitions (default 3)
rows - per-historyId dual-definition rows
warnings - non-fatal notes
Enclosing class:
FlakeModels
public static record FlakeModels.FlakeTable(String schemaVersion, boolean empty, String emptyMessage, int windowSize, int transitionThreshold, List<FlakeModels.FlakeRow> rows, List<String> warnings) extends Record
Flake table for IDE / MCP report_flake / CLI shaft report flake.
